en: Black‑and‑white view through a stone and iron gate toward a traditional half‑timbered house with a steep tiled roof, set among trees and a walled garden. Behind it, terraced hillsides planted with vines rise up; on one hill stands a round tower and on a distant ridge a larger hilltop complex that resembles a historic castle or monastery. A small plastered house with an open window stands in front of the main building, and a low stone wall runs along the street in the foreground.
